Self.Wiki: This map object represents a platoon setup for an ensemble.

PlatoonIDScriptActivate.Wiki: The platoon script to use for this ensemble

State.Wiki: The initial reflect state of this ensemble; 0 or 1. AI scripts change it later with the platoon Lua function SetReflectState.

EnableDeactiveMove.Wiki: The initial value of the platoon's enable-deactive-move flag, which AI scripts change later with the platoon Lua function SetEnableDeactiveMove. ON for two retail platoons.

UseMemberEntityIDs.Wiki: If ON, the characters in Member Entity IDs also join the platoon.

MemberEntityIDs.Wiki: Entity IDs of characters that join the platoon when Use Member Entity IDs is ON. 10000 is the player; 0 or -1 for none.

GroupPartsNames.Wiki: A character that belongs to this platoon.
